roads.name: Point Imperial Road
words: Properly twisty: 18 curves in 2.2 miles, about 8 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 8,285 to 8,809 ft, with 529 ft of up and down along the way.
July highs average 76°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 35 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.37 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.

roads.name: Bitter Springs–Utah State Line Highway
words: Sweeping and steady: 8 curves in 3.0 miles.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
From 3,141 to 4,099 ft, with 1,708 ft of up and down along the way.
21 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
July highs average 98°F.
